decisions.proposed_text:
Dựa theo số Skill tăng Speed đang có (tối đa 3),
Speed Bonus
decisions.reason: Preserve Skill/Speed and replace the support-effect calque with canonical Speed Bonus.
decisions.terminology_basis: common.stat.speed → Speed; common.skill.generic → Skill; support.speed_bonus.effect155 → Speed Bonus
